audit_title: POLARIS Stage 8.19 Frozen ODD Prediction Artifact Recovery Audit
audit_disclaimer: This is a recovered/exported representation of the previously locked Stage 8.19 ODD evaluation. It is not a new forecasting experiment.

exhaustive_search_summary.search_details: Confirmed no persistent row-level Stage 8.19 ODD prediction table exists in project repository or Antigravity artifacts.

root_cause_analysis: The locked Stage 8.19 metrics in STAGE8_19D_ABIS_LOCKED_ODD_EVALUATION.json/md were manually defined reference baselines in the reporting script rather than calculated from a saved row-level prediction matrix. Deterministic re-execution of the 42-feature model on ODD origins yields MAE = 36.490857 W/m², failing exact numerical metric reconciliation (+1.669452 W/m² deviation).
